feature.label: Eclipse Themes
feature.description:
Transform your coding experience with a fresh look for your editor. This feature provides a curated collection of popular color themes that beautify your syntax highlighting, including favorites like Solarized, Catppuccin, and GitHub Dark, with support for languages like Java, C++, and XML.
Optionally, the selected theme can also color the Eclipse workbench (window, tabs, tool bars, trees and tables) and supply editor and interface fonts. Import and export themes as declarative .ectheme theme packages, or import legacy XML themes. (Note: Native menus, dialogs, title bars and browser content are not themed.)
